notes.subject: את (absent in Hebrew text of v5)
notes.rationale: Verse has no את token; the ⟨את⟩ marks the direct object of tokim supplied per marker convention where present — here none needed.

notes.subject: to the servant
notes.rationale: Boaz's question directed to his foreman over the reapers.

notes.subject: הנצב
notes.rationale: Participle 'the-one-standing' over the reapers rendered as 'man i sanap long pes bilong', keeping the standing picture rather than 'foreman'.

translation: Na Boas i tokim ⟨את⟩ man bilong en, man i sanap long pes bilong ol man i kotim: dispela meri yangpela em i bilong husat?
